review_scope: Author-side AI source-only cross-read of source/build/PDF binding, preservation of S at P, complete P archive membership, standalone ZIP/part verification, and virtual chunk descriptors.
resolved_defects: Standalone verifier now requires exactly the four document PDF paths in both inventories and the required-publication input set.
Embedded source commit, repository tree, native revision tree and path identities are cross-checked against the package source identity.
Source and publication file/byte/readback totals are checked; JSON metadata is parsed from the exact hash-bound bytes.
limitations: Source review does not establish actual source publication, successful PDF compilation, ZIP creation, remote upload, or CI success. Virtual chunk descriptors are not physical/uploaded parts.
